errors.text_span: 七个不同的语义依存关系类别
errors.evidence: The horizontal axis shows five categories, not seven.
The labels on the horizontal axis are multi-character words (避免, 回避, 逃避, 躲避, 规避), not the single characters listed. The description also incorrectly lists seven labels for five categories.
For the category "规避" (referred to as "规"), the data values range from approximately 2% to 33.5%, not from 11% to 38%.

errors.text_span: 每个类别都表示了三种不同用的颜色
errors.evidence: There are 11 different series, each with its own color, as shown in the legend, not three.

errors.text_span: 蓝色表示“AGT”，棕色表示“EXP”，浅蓝色表示“PAT”，黄色表示“DATV”，绿色表示“CONT”，橙色表示“TIME”，淡紫色表示“LOC”，橘色表示“MANN”，浅绿黄色表示“MEAS”，浅橙黄色表示“eCOO”，淡蓝色表示“eSUCC”
errors.evidence: The description of colors corresponding to the legend items is largely incorrect. For example, it states '棕色表示“EXP”' (brown for EXP), but EXP is orange. It says '绿色表示“CONT”' (green for CONT), but CONT is dark blue. It says '浅蓝色表示“PAT”' (light blue for PAT), but PAT is grey. Numerous other mappings are also incorrect.
